This is https://huggingface.co/kingabzpro/Qwen-3-32B-Medical-Reasoning applied to https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-32B
[Original model card](https://huggingface.co/kingabzpro/Qwen-3-32B-Medical-Reasoning) created by [@kingabzpro](https://huggingface.co/kingabzpro)

## Fine-tuning Qwen3-32B in 4-bit Quantization for Medical Reasoning

This project fine-tunes the [`Qwen/Qwen3-32B`](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-32B) model using a medical reasoning dataset (`FreedomIntelligence/medical-o1-reasoning-SFT`) with **4-bit quantization** for memory-efficient training.

serving.notes: nicoboss's repository is 14 BF16 shards (32,762,123,264 parameters) and has no adapter_config.json. The intro says the kingabzpro adapter was applied to Qwen/Qwen3-32B, so this release is the merged model. kingabzpro/Qwen-3-32B-Medical-Reasoning is the LoRA adapter (adapter_model.safetensors, r 64, lora_alpha 16, dropout 0.05, targets q_proj, k_proj, v_proj, o_proj, gate_proj, up_proj, down_proj). The DataCamp tutorial, by the same author as that adapter, uses SFTTrainer, num_train_epochs 1, learning_rate 2e-4, per_device_train_batch_size 1, gradient_accumulation_steps 2, and load_in_4bit NF4. max_new_tokens 1200 is from the card's usage script. generation_config.json sets temperature 0.6, top_k 20, top_p 0.95, do_sample true. config.json max_position_embeddings is 40960. The chat template is the Qwen3 template and does not set this medical instruction; the instruction is inside the card's prompt. The usage comment says "original model from Meta" while base_model_id is Qwen/Qwen3-32B. The card's "50 minutes" and the tutorial's "42 minutes" are both stated. CureAgent (arXiv:2512.05576) cites https://huggingface.co/nicoboss/Qwen-3-32B-Medical-Reasoning and reports 36.513 and 40.791 on two leaderboard phases. HuatuoGPT-o1 was not re-read in full.

evaluation_reported.text: The model card reports no score. CureAgent (arXiv:2512.05576) names this repository and lists Qwen-3-32B-Medical-Reasoning at 36.513 on phase 1 and 40.791 on phase 2 of its table.

discrepancies: Inventory methods is lora. The card and the training tutorial load Qwen/Qwen3-32B in 4-bit NF4 and train a LoRA adapter, which is QLoRA. nicoboss publishes merged BF16 weights. Dataset id and parent match. The card says both 500 and 2000 examples; the tutorial code uses the first 2000 English rows.
